programme.desc: Sleep Theory frontman Cullen Moore joins Joel Madden to talk about his journey from serving in the U.S. Army to fronting one of modern rock’s fastest-rising bands. Moore reflects on his Memphis roots, discovering his sound, and how TikTok helped launch Sleep Theory to viral success. The two explore discipline, creativity, and how music became Moore’s true “Plan A.”

programme.title: Urzila Carlson: It’s Personal (2024)
programme.desc: Urzila Carlson performs her stand-up special filmed in Brisbane, delivering sharp humor and personal stories from her global tour.

programme.title: Good Charlotte: Live at Brixton Academy (2026)
programme.desc: Good Charlotte performs live at Brixton Academy, delivering hits from The Young and the Hopeless in a high-energy concert.

programme.title: Carmen Christopher: Live from the Windy City (2026)
programme.desc: Comedian Carmen Christopher returns home to Chicago for a sharp, surreal, and hilarious stand-up special that blends the absurd with the heartfelt. With quick wit and offbeat honesty, Christopher riffs on social media, family, dating, politics, and Midwest life in a performance that’s both painfully self-aware and laugh-out-loud ridiculous. Executive produced by Tim Robinson and Zach Kanin.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Travie McCoy discusses his gradual rise in music, from humble beginnings to headlining. He shares a metaphor from his album cover and tells a story about breaking his neck riding a dirt bike.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Daryl Palumbo of Glassjaw and Head Automatica. Daryl reflects on three decades of genre-defying music, the freedom he’s always pursued as an artist, the self-doubt and restlessness that shaped his work, and how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling experience of his life.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: James Taylor: Live at the Beacon Theatre (2026)
programme.desc: James Taylor performs live at the Beacon Theatre, delivering songs from Hourglass alongside classics in a special concert featuring unseen footage.

programme.title: Anthony Green: So Long, Avalon Live In New York (2025)
programme.desc: Experience Anthony Green live from the Gramercy Theatre in New York as he celebrates the release of So Long, Avalon. An intimate, high–energy set blends new material with fan favorites, spontaneous crowd moments, and a playful nod to classic “Kokomo.” Green spotlights his touring band — Greg Mervine (drums), Sean Cohen (multi-instrumentalist), Dave Davison, and Keith Goodwin — and shouts out friends Kurt Travis and Geoff Rickly for helping shape a special night. A dynamic performance that captures Green’s voice, humor, and gratitude in a room full of true believers.

programme.title: New Order on Power, Corruption & Lies (2025)
programme.desc: Record On explores the making of New Order’s groundbreaking 1983 album Power, Corruption & Lies and its defining single “Blue Monday.” Featuring Bernard Sumner, Peter Hook, Stephen Morris, and Gillian Gilbert, the episode examines how the band evolved from the tragedy of Joy Division into pioneering electronic innovators inspired by New York’s club scene.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Drummer and producer Cody Hanson of Hinder joins Joel Madden to reflect on two decades of the band’s journey—from college shows in Oklahoma to multi-platinum success with “Lips of an Angel.” They discuss songwriting, evolving as musicians, and the making of their new single “Bring Me Back to Life.”

programme.title: Lamb of God: Killadelphia (2026)
programme.desc: Lamb of God's Killadelphia showcases the thrash-metal band at The Trocadero in 2005, featuring a recorded set, candid footage, and an all-access portrait.

programme.title: Queen: Live at the Rainbow '74 (2026)
programme.desc: Queen performs a 1974 concert at London’s Rainbow Theatre, capturing the band’s early rise with a powerful live set.

programme.title: Los Lonely Boys: Live at the Fillmore (2026)
programme.desc: Live At The Fillmore finds Texican rock trio Los Lonely Boys blowing the roof off the legendary San Francisco venue with their hits "Heaven" and "More Than Love" plus covers of Richie Valens' "La Bamba" and War's "Cisco Kid." This event was captured in 2005.

programme.title: Chase Atlantic: Live from Hollywood (2026)
programme.desc: Chase Atlantic, an Australian trio based in LA, produce unique pop rock/R&B fusion. Their sound is identifiable through Mitchel Cave’s vocals and danceable tracks.

programme.title: A Wedding for Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Haley Foster built a big city life in Los Angeles as a top wedding planner at an elite and powerful company run by Ms. Reynolds. When her sister, Angela, insists on getting married Christmas Day on the tree farm in their old hometown of Truxton, Haley is resigned to make her sister’s dreams come true and her parents happy.

programme.title: Christmas in Palm Springs (2014)
programme.desc: Jessica has a big presentation in Palm Springs. There are a couple of problems though: her two kids who will do anything to get mom and dad back together again - even if they have to hack mom's phone or pose as a secretary to make sure dad's in Palm Springs too. And father Joe who'll do anything to charm his way back into Jessica's life.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Tail (2025)
programme.desc: This Christmas, Riley Harper fights to save her small-town animal rescue from closing. Across the ocean, Prince Edward of Arendale travels to America to secure a land deal—unaware the property belongs to Riley. When fate (and a lost dog tag) brings them together, sparks fly. But when Riley learns Edward’s true identity, her trust shatters. On Christmas Eve, Edward risks it all to save her shelter—and her heart.

programme.title: Saving Christmas Spirit (2022)
programme.desc: When brilliant and sharp-witted archaeologist Lucy Stewart decides to spend her Christmas break in the Scottish Highlands, she goes on a quest to find the ruins of a shrine to an ancient goddess. Through her journey, she learns the importance of letting a little festive wonder back into her life and discovers both history and love along the way.

programme.title: Saving Christmas Spirit (2022)
programme.desc: When brilliant and sharp-witted archaeologist Lucy Stewart decides to spend her Christmas break in the Scottish Highlands, she goes on a quest to find the ruins of a shrine to an ancient goddess. programme.title: Wrapped Up in Christmas (2017)
programme.desc: Heather, a hardworking mall manager, must make tough holiday cuts—including ending leases on struggling stores—to earn a promotion. Focused on her career, she’s given up on love, but her spirited niece Molly hasn’t. Molly asks the mall Santa for a Christmas boyfriend for Heather—unaware he’s actually Ryan, a mall worker secretly helping his aunt’s failing toy shop. Can love survive their hidden truths?

programme.title: Christmas A La Mode (2019)
programme.desc: Emily is determined to fulfil her father�s wishes to save the family dairy farm which has been financially struggling for years. When a handsome stranger, Charlie, shows up at Emily�s family dairy farm at Christmastime, Emily has to hide her feelings for him when he turns out to be her sister�s partner and they are there to sell the farm. Can Emily get her Christmas miracle to save the family farm and win the handsome guy in the end?

programme.title: The Christmas Checklist (2022)
programme.desc: Emily is faced with the daunting task of fulfilling her late mother Ruby’s last wish – a twelve-task Christmas Checklist. With local freelance writer Noah covering her compelling story, his article turns from inspiring to cherished just in time for Christmas Eve, as their journey together reveals that Ruby’s final wish has been in front of them the whole time.

programme.title: Christmas Keepsake (2023)
programme.desc: Single father, Tom and his daughter, Grace make the big move from the sunny land of Australia to the quaint US town of Ashbury Grove. While exploring her new backyard, Grace finds a mysterious time capsule, containing a guide to a perfect family Christmas. The two tasks themselves with finding its owner which leads them to finding love and their own perfect family Christmas.

programme.title: Christmas at Fields Ranch (2025)
programme.desc: Daisy, a determined real estate broker, inherits her grandfather’s ranch just before Christmas. Focused on selling, she returns home only to reconnect with Ben, her childhood crush who now works as a ranch hand. As holiday traditions stir memories and rekindle old feelings, Daisy begins to question the fast-paced career she’s built. With the season drawing to a close, she must decide between ambition and love.

programme.title: Christmas on the Ranch (2024)
programme.desc: A big-city relationship expert, famous for dishing out advice on her hit talk show, finds her carefully curated life unraveling when she gets stranded at a small-town ranch just before Christmas. Forced to trade cameras and cue cards for chores and quiet nights, she clashes—and sparks—with the rugged rancher who takes her in. As holiday magic weaves around them, she learns that love, unpolished and unscripted, could be her most life-changing lesson.

programme.title: Exes of Christmas Past (2025)
programme.desc: An ambitious hotel manager returns to her hometown for Christmas, planning only a short visit at her family’s charming B&B. To her surprise, the inn is booked solid—with her three high school exes among the guests. As old rivalries resurface and sparks fly, she’s swept into a holiday whirlwind of laughter, mishaps, and second chances. Amid the festive chaos, she discovers love may have been waiting all along.

programme.title: A Merry Single Christmas (2022)
programme.desc: Morgan has lost her Christmas spirit after breaking up with her long time boyfriend, Liam. She decides to go to a retreat called The Christmas Lonely Hearts Club where she hopes to rekindle her Christmas spirit. Things seem to be going well until her Ex shows up. Morgan and Liam will have to conceal their previous relationship while trying to discover what it means to be single. What they don’t realize is that adhering to the “no romance” policy might require a Christmas miracle.

programme.title: Christmas on Repeat (2022)
programme.desc: An ad executive, overwhelmed by work, is granted a magical do-over of the holidays by Santa. As she relives the same festive days, she begins to recognize how much time she’s missed with her family. Through the repeating moments, she learns to slow down, cherish loved ones, and find balance between career and personal life. The story highlights the importance of connection, presence, and appreciating the people who matter most.

programme.title: A Christmas Cruise (2024)
programme.desc: A single, successful writer decides to do double duty when her best friend invites her on a Christmas Cruise and decides to see if finding true love during the holidays can really happen or will it be just another holiday story.

programme.title: Jail en Español

programme.title: Jail en Español

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre arrestado les canta a los oficiales. Una mujer es acusada de robo. Los oficiales no se dejan engañar por las lágrimas fingidas de una mujer joven.

programme.desc: An unlicensed contractor sues for damages after a married couple stops payment on a $4200 check for demolition work. They accuse him of property theft and dispute payment for a tractor rental.

programme.desc: A man accuses his sister of kidnapping his special-needs teenager who was, unbeknownst to him, in need of life-saving, emergency brain surgery. The sister is seeking reimbursement for costs associated with that surgery and return of her nephew’s property.

programme.sub-title: Post-Funeral Property Fail and Not a Pleasure Doing Business

programme.desc: Bad blood between unwed parents leads to a fight over a three-year-old car accident and an attempt to collect far more than the car is worth. Jail time, alleged domestic violence and admitted drug use come into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In a small Idaho farming community, a teenager sells four piglets to a neighbor and expects to be paid in full. The buyer claims all four animals died and that he owes nothing.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops between a male nurse and a female inmate through a prison pen pal program. Soon after her release, their once-supportive relationship devolves into a fight over stimulus checks and a car loan.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: What Not to Teach Your Teenager and Padding the Bill?
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, despite eye-witness testimony, a man insists that his unlicensed girlfriend was not driving his truck when it backed into a neighbor's house. His teenage son backs up his story. Next, a mechanic refuses to return a woman's wrecked car until he is paid; she admits to spending insurance money intended for car repairs on her own personal expenses.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A senior victim of bank fraud seeks restitution from her teenage, great granddaughter who made the mistake of accepting mysterious checks from an ex-con relative.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Teenagers who met in foster care get into a catfight over a boy. Their fight escalates into an aggressive act of caught-on-tape vandalism, an arrest and a 10K lawsuit.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Love Triangle Drama and Halloween Party Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. First, a young woman breaks up with her live-in boyfriend and starts to date their new roommate. The ex-boyfriend sues the happy new couple for $10K and for the return of his two cats. Next, business partners pay $6K to rent a party space for teens; they sue for breach of contract when event restrictions are put in place without their approval.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man is sued for alleged failure to pay his late mother's caregiver. He accuses the healthcare worker of contributing to the 'delinquency of an elderly patient' by giving his dying mother cigarettes and marijuana.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A 14-year-old girl steals her mother's car, goes on a joyride and T-bones an unsuspecting motorist on her way to work. The teenager runs from the crash site; the injured motorist leaves in an ambulance.
